COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Jan-21-2005 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on as re-assigned by the PJ. for settlement on the record and Prove-Up Hearing.
Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
John Zanghi, Esq. for Plaintiff: American Hotel Inc., represented by Pete Maulolo, property manager.
Defendant: Priscilla Shipley, present in pro per.
Co-Defendant: Mary Halstein, not present, DEFAULT entered 12-7-04.
Parties present in court and reached a settlement by stipulation, terms as follows:
Stipulation for Entry of Judgment against the defendant: Shipley, for restitution and possession of the premises of the property located at: 735 Taylor St., #507, San Francisco.
Defendant to vacate on or before 5 p.m. Feb. 1, 2005. Writ of Execution for possession shall be stayed until Feb. 1, 2005, if defendant make a partial payment of $300.00 on or before Jan. 24, 2005, and monthly payment of $75.00 starting March 1, 2005 for 18 monthly installment, total of $1,650.00 for DAMAGES.
Each party waives claim against the other, each to bears its own costs and fees.
Any items left in the premises will be disposed of.
Security deposits shall be retained by the plaintiff.
No one else occupying the premises who claims a right to possession.
Parties agreed to terms of the settlement in open court.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.

Prove-Up Hearing as to Co-Defendant: Mary Halstein.
Exhibit 1---Three day notice dtd.10-20-04 --------------------------ID/EVID.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant: Mary Halstein as follows:
Back rent and damages $9,624.56
Costs $349.60 for a total of $9,974.16
Counsel stipulated for the return of exhibit in open court and to prepare ONE Judgment for signature.
Jan. 21, 2005
Judgment signed by Comm. Kaplan.
